sourcedFrom: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 (2015)
cleanIntro: IWI's own six-step strip for the Jericho 941: hammer cocked, slide eased back until two witness marks line up, slide catch lever pushed out from the far side, then slide, recoil spring and barrel. The witness marks are the whole trick — the catch lever only clears in one position, and no amount of force finds it anywhere else.

steps.title: Safety on, magazine out, safety off, slide back
steps.action: Muzzle in a safe direction the whole time. Set the safety to SAFE, press the magazine catch and take the magazine out, THEN set the safety to FIRE and pull the slide fully back to eject any chambered round. That order is IWI's own and it is deliberate: the magazine leaves the pistol while the safety is still on, so nothing can feed while your hand is on the slide.
steps.aside: Pull the slide to the rear and eject any chambered cartridge.
steps.quote: Press the magazine catch and remove the magazine.
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Unloading the Pistol, step 2, printed p.36 (PDF page 38)

steps.title: Chamber looked at with the slide held open
steps.action: With the slide back, look into the chamber and confirm it is empty. Do it deliberately — the Jericho's ejection port is not large and a case rim hides easily against a carbon-blackened breech face. Then return the slide forward.
steps.aside: Return the slide to the forward position.
steps.quote: While the slide is in the rear position, visually check to make certain that the chamber is empty.
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Unloading the Pistol, step 5, printed p.36 (PDF page 38)

steps.title: Hammer lowered on the empty chamber, safety back on
steps.action: IWI's unloading sequence ends by releasing the hammer with the trigger and then setting the safety to SAFE. This is a double-action hammer gun, so that press happens with the chamber you have just inspected — check it again if any doubt has crept in. On a Jericho with the R-model slide-mounted lever the safety also de-cocks; on the F and FS the lever is on the frame and does not.
steps.aside: Set the safety in the "SAFE" position.
steps.quote: Release the hammer by squeezing the trigger.
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Unloading the Pistol, step 7, printed p.36 (PDF page 38)

steps.title: Which Jericho you have — check before you strip
steps.action: This manual covers the PL, PSL, F and FS models: PL and PSL are the polymer-frame guns, F and FS the steel-frame ones, all with a frame-mounted safety. IWI publishes a separate manual for the Jericho II and II-M, which is a different pistol, and a separate two-page insert for the R, RS and RB models whose ambidextrous safety sits on the SLIDE and also de-cocks. Care and handling are the same across the models this book covers; the safety lever is where they differ.
steps.prose: The JERICHO PL/PSL refers to a light weight polymer-frame, with frame-mounted safety and F/FS refers to a steel frame, with frame-mounted safety.
steps.quote: Care and handling are the same for all models. They share most parts in common as well.
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Preface, printed p.19 (PDF page 21)
steps.warn: If your safety lever is on the slide rather than the frame, you have an R-series gun and its safety de-cocks the hammer — that behaviour is documented in a separate insert, not in this book.

steps.title: Confirmed empty, hammer cocked, safety to FIRE
steps.action: Before a part moves, check again that there is no magazine in the pistol and no live round in the chamber. Then move the safety to FIRE and cock the hammer by hand. The hammer has to be back for the strip — with it down, the slide will not sit where the witness marks meet.
steps.caution: Before disassembling the pistol, check that there is no magazine in the pistol, nor a live round in the chamber.
steps.quote: With the pistol completely unloaded, move the safety to the "FIRE" position, and manually move the hammer to the cocked position (Fig. 13).
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Disassembling the Pistol, step 1, printed p.38 (PDF page 40)

steps.title: Slide eased back until the two witness marks line up
steps.action: Push the slide slightly rearward until the mark at the REAR END of the slide sits just above the mark on the frame. This is a small, precise movement — not a full rack — and the alignment is what frees the slide catch lever. Hold the pistol there; let the slide creep and the lever locks up again.
steps.quote: Push the slide slightly to the rear (1) until the mark at the rear end of the slide is just above the mark on the frame (2) (Fig. 14).
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Disassembling the Pistol, step 2, printed p.38 (PDF page 40)

steps.title: Slide catch lever pushed out from the opposite side
steps.action: Holding the marks aligned, remove the slide catch lever by pushing on the pin of the lever from the OPPOSITE side of the frame. You push from one side and the lever comes away on the other; trying to pull the lever itself just fights the detent. If it will not move, the marks are not lined up — go back a step rather than adding force.
steps.quote: While holding the pistol in that position, remove the slide catch lever by pushing the pin of the lever on the opposite side of the frame (Fig. 15).
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Disassembling the Pistol, step 3, printed p.38 (PDF page 40)

steps.title: Slide off the front, recoil spring out, barrel out
steps.action: With the catch lever out, pull the slide forward off the frame. Lift the recoil spring out of its housing under the barrel, then take the barrel out of the slide. The Jericho runs its slide INSIDE the frame rails rather than outside, which is why the slide comes off cleanly forward once the lever is gone.
steps.prose: Remove the barrel from the slide (Fig. 18).
steps.aside: Remove the recoil spring from its housing under the barrel (Fig. 17).
steps.quote: Pull the slide from the frame (Fig. 16).
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Disassembling the Pistol, step 4, printed p.39 (PDF page 41)

steps.title: Field strip complete — and the manual says stop
steps.action: Slide, frame, barrel and recoil spring. IWI prints its stop notice on the same page as the last strip step, in the WARNING box: nothing further is required or advised for routine maintenance. The chapter's General paragraph adds the consequence — taking any other parts off is not recommended and voids all warranties. Clean these four and reassemble.
steps.quote: No further disassembly is required or advised for routine maintenance.
steps.cite: IWI JERICHO® 941™ PL/PSL/F/FS Semi Automatic Double Action Pistols Operation Manual — 08.011.08.15.00 — Disassembling the Pistol, WARNING, printed p.39 (PDF page 41)
steps.warn: Disassembling or assembling of any other parts is not recommended and will void all warranties.

deepAbsentReason: The Jericho book publishes ONE disassembly procedure — the six-step strip on printed pp.38-39 — and closes it with a WARNING that no further disassembly is required or advised for routine maintenance, plus a General paragraph on printed p.37 stating that disassembling or assembling any other parts is not recommended and voids all warranties. Its Care and Cleaning chapter (printed pp.44-46) calls for nothing beyond that strip and the magazines. There is no firing pin, extractor, sear or hammer procedure anywhere in the 74 pages. The Parts List & Exploded View (printed pp.51-64) is a parts-identification drawing, not a teardown, and nothing was constructed from it.

cleaning.name: BARREL, CHAMBER & BORE
tasks: Run the brass wire brush completely through the chamber and bore until it protrudes from the far end, then withdraw it and repeat several times
Clean the bore with a patch moistened with powder solvent, then repeat with clean dry patches
Wipe the barrel's exterior and its locking lugs

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Work around the extractor and firing pin until all powder residue is removed
Use a small brush, swabs and solvent for the areas you cannot otherwise reach
On a new pistol, remove any heavy or sticky protective material first
Never use abrasive or metallic objects for cleaning

cleaning.name: FRAME & MOVING PARTS
tasks: Oil the chamber, bore and all moving parts with a lightly oiled patch or cloth, then take the excess off with a dry one
Inspect every part for wear and damage as you go
Check the surfaces are free of rust and any chrome coating is not peeling

cleaning.name: MAGAZINES
tasks: Care and cleaning includes the magazines — do not skip them
Keep the magazine body and follower free of grit
Check the magazine is intact and never loaded past its stated capacity

reassembly: Insert the barrel in the slide and seat it in its rearmost, locked position.
Press the recoil spring down towards the barrel until it seats securely in the recess in the bottom lug of the barrel.
Mount the slide on the frame and push it rearward until the two marks line up one above the other, then insert the slide catch pin until it snaps into place.
Check correct pistol operation by cocking it.
Check trigger and hammer operation and verify that the safety is functioning properly and safely.
fncheck: IWI's own closing checks are to cock the pistol and confirm it operates correctly, then check trigger and hammer operation and verify the safety is functioning properly and safely. With the pistol confirmed empty, cycle the slide and confirm it returns fully into battery, confirm the slide catch lever is fully seated and holds the slide open on an empty magazine, and confirm the double-action and single-action trigger both function before the pistol is handled as ready. Before investigating any malfunction, the manual requires that the pistol is properly assembled, that it is properly cleaned and lubricated with barrel, chamber and slide head completely dry, that the ammunition has been inspected and approved, and that the magazine is intact and not overloaded.
